mapper.select: , person_mm AS ( SELECT a.dev_id,m.work_ym,sum(m.mm_qty) AS mm FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id WHERE a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND m.work_ym <= #{month} GROUP BY a.dev_id,m.work_ym ), labor AS ( SELECT p.work_ym AS month,sum(floor(coalesce(s.indv_lbr_cst_amt,0)::numeric*p.mm/greatest(t.mm,1.00))) AS amount FROM project_mm p JOIN person_mm t ON t.dev_id=p.dev_id AND t.work_ym=p.work_ym LEFT JOIN cst.mth_cst s ON s.dev_id=p.dev_id AND s.cst_ym=p.work_ym GROUP BY p.work_ym ), expenses AS ( SELECT expns_ym AS month,sum(expns_amt::numeric) AS amount FROM cst.drct_expns WHERE prj_id=#{projectId} AND expns_ym <= #{month} GROUP BY expns_ym ), calculated AS ( SELECT month,sum(amount) AS amount FROM ( SELECT month,amount FROM labor UNION ALL SELECT month,amount FROM expenses ) values_by_month GROUP BY month ) SELECT coalesce(c.month,v.month) AS month,coalesce(c.amount,v.amount)::bigint AS amount FROM closed c FULL JOIN calculated v ON v.month=c.month ORDER BY month

SELECT DISTINCT p.work_ym FROM project_mm p WHERE p.mm > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cst.mth_cst s WHERE s.dev_id=p.dev_id AND s.cst_ym=p.work_ym) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM closed c WHERE c.month=p.work_ym) ORDER BY p.work_ym
